next.reason: 1985 RH lower limit: a) FIRST DETAIL - 1; b) page limit (NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE). 2023 §2023:13.18.57.4 GR8 a) page limit when alone (also §2023:13.18.39.4 GR4), b) 'the line preceding the first line of the page heading', FIRST DETAIL - 1 only if no page heading is defined (§2023:13.18.39.4 GR2 d keeps 'terminates before this line'). With a page heading defined the RH bound is tighter than the 1985 rule's FD-1. The 1985 page heading presentation rules (printed XIII-30/31) are absent from the scan, so no visible 1985 rule supplies the same bound; measured against the visible 1985 text this is stricter.
